changes.title: Header and field validation step
changes.description: New step 2 added: 'Validate the header and numeric fields.' Previous version had no validation gate.
changes.operator_impact: Reduces risk of processing malformed CSV data. Adds a manual or automated gate before computation, increasing operator workload slightly but improving data integrity.

changes.title: Revenue calculation now includes units
changes.description: Step text changed from 'Calculate total revenue.' to 'Calculate total revenue and units.'
changes.operator_impact: Operator must now also compute a units metric. Slightly more work per run, but produces richer output.

changes.title: Output file format changed from .txt to .md
changes.description: Step text changed from 'Save the summary as reports/monthly-sales.txt.' to 'Save the summary as reports/monthly-sales.md.'
changes.operator_impact: Output is now Markdown instead of plain text. Operators using downstream Markdown-aware tools will benefit; plain-text consumers will need adjustment.

changes.title: Removed 'send without review' instruction
changes.description: The previous step 'Send the summary without a separate review step.' was removed entirely. Replaced by review and publish steps in both successors.
changes.operator_impact: Introduces a quality gate. The operator can no longer bypass review; both successors require human verification before distribution.

changes.title: Review step replaced with PR-based publish workflow
changes.description: Step 5 changed from 'Review the result before sharing it.' to 'Publish the summary through the project PR workflow.'
changes.operator_impact: Replaces an informal review-and-share step with a structured pull-request workflow. Introduces version control discipline and peer review, adding collaboration overhead but improving traceability.

unchanged_sections.description: Step 1 — 'Export the monthly sales CSV.' is identical across all three files.
Steps 1-4 in current.md are identical to steps 1-4 in next_draft.md (validation, calculation, and save steps).

summary.previous_to_current: Two major improvements (data validation and review gating) plus a format change (.txt to .md).
summary.current_to_next_draft: Single substantive change: replacing an informal review-and-share step with a formal PR-based publish workflow. No steps removed.
